items.problem: Inventory desktop navbar architecture, roles, permissions and duplicate actions before refactor

Remove duplicate Search/equivalent actions

Normalize icon/label alignment, hit areas, active, hover and focus states
Apply black/graphite/electric-red visual system without Bootstrap blue/glass regressions
Introduce progressive compact breakpoints before collision
Validate no horizontal overflow, clipping, overlap or wrapping at 1280px 100%
Validate navbar at 1366px 100%
Validate navbar at 1440px 100%
Validate navbar at 1536px 100%
Validate navbar at 1920px 100%
Validate navbar at 2560px 100%
Validate critical desktop widths at browser zoom 125%
Verify routes, permissions, notifications, invitations, context and administrative actions
Add automated functional/visual regression coverage when viable
Capture before/after evidence and only verify after repeated visual and functional passes
